frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole adult animal: robust early sauropodomorph hindquarters and relatively shortened forequarters. Not hatchling, partial skeleton or a recoloured Massospondylus.

scientific_limits.en: Original living reconstruction based on a published adult composite, not a complete single skeleton. Adult skull is missing; Otero2019 used a scaled Plateosaurus skull and restored missing tail parts with Plateosaurus. Our conservative head and tail are likewise inferred, not direct Mussaurus adult cranial evidence. Scale and soft tissue are approximate.
scientific_limits.zh: 依据已发表成年合成骨架制作完整活体美术复原，并非完整单一标本。成年头骨未保存，2019研究借用等比例板龙头骨并补配尾部；本作头尾缺失部分同样属于推断，不称作鼠龙成年头骨实证。尺度和软组织为估计。

scale.basis: Approximate display length estimated from Figure1d adult reconstruction and its100cm bar; not a fossil total-length measurement. Published adult femur0.726m supplies independent proportion anchor.

diagnostic_targets: Deep robust ribcage and substantial pelvis/upper thighs, not the slender neck-dominated Massospondylus body.
Short free forelimbs contrasted with robust longer hindlimbs in adult bipedal stance; no hatchling quadrupedal proportions.
Substantial muscular tail base with long tapering tail; tail bulk integral to adult silhouette.
Moderately long neck and small conservative head, no invented cranial crest or oversized embryo skull.
Grasping hands facing inward, not load-bearing columnar sauropod forefeet.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Otero etal2019 Figure1d actual adult fossil elements and gray-preserved-bone reconstruction personally inspected. Composite MLP68-II-27-1, MLP60-III-20-22, MLP61-III-20-23. Different-age panels a-c are not adult reference.

reference_credits.title: Ontogenetic changes in the body plan of Mussaurus patagonicus reveal shifts of locomotor stance during growth
